changeSet.comment: nexus-p2m1x.20 (RDR-229 P3.3b): nexus.partition_ensure_leaf (vectors-034-1's body) also creates the id unique index on a new leaf of nexus.chunks or nexus.taxonomy_centroids when the parent does not yet carry the id UNIQUE constraint (CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on the new, empty leaf, named the leaf's name plus _cid_uq); with the constraint PostgreSQL's own index serves and none is made. Function definition only. DATA EFFECT: none. No row of any table is read or written and no existing leaf changes. The rollback restores vectors-034-1's body verbatim; a leaf index made meanwhile stays (harmless).
